key_path: Start a free trial at freshworks.com (work email, company name). This creates <subdomain>.freshdesk.com (or .freshservice.com)
Verify email / activate account via link
Profile settings > View API key (may require completing a captcha)
Call REST v2 with HTTP Basic auth: API key as username, 'X' as password, against https://<subdomain>.freshdesk.com/api/v2/
MCP: point the client at https://<subdomain>.freshdesk.com/mcp with the API key in the Authorization header (Growth plan or higher)
human_gates_notes: No card for the trial. MCP is plan-gated (Growth/Pro/Enterprise) with monthly/annual action caps, so post-trial use effectively needs a paid plan. No regulatory gate.

agent_native_auth.cli_login: partial. The Freshworks FDK CLI is for building marketplace apps, not for minting API keys
agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: no for Freshdesk (API key only). Freshservice MCP supports OAuth 2.0 + API key
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mint_keys: no. One personal API key per agent user
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: no. The key inherits the agent user's role permissions; scope by creating a restricted agent
agent_native_auth.sandbox_test_credentials: sandbox exists on higher plans (Enterprise); the trial account itself serves as the test env
agent_native_auth.free_tier: trial (14-21 days); MCP actions included per plan (e.g. Growth 25/min)

remote.url: https://<subdomain>.freshdesk.com/mcp (custom domains not supported); Freshservice equivalent
remote.auth: API key in Authorization header (Freshdesk); OAuth 2.0 or API key (Freshservice)

mcp.status: GA 2026-09-10. EAP pricing/limits took effect Oct 2026. Limits: Growth 25 actions/min, Pro 50, Enterprise 100; annual action allowances (1,200/6,000/12,000)
mcp.one_click_install: no. JSON/CLI snippets for Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Copilot Studio

docs_for_agents.llms_txt: yes at marketing level. https://www.freshworks.com/llms.txt (last updated 2025-12-17, slightly stale, has disambiguation guide). No llms.txt on developers.freshworks.com or developers.freshdesk.com (404)
docs_for_agents.openapi: no official OpenAPI spec URL found for Freshdesk v2 API

score_justification: A per-tenant hosted MCP is now GA and the API key is trivially found, but there is no OAuth for Freshdesk MCP, no key scoping or minting API, no dev-docs llms.txt, and MCP is metered and plan-gated.
best_practice: The MCP lives on the customer's own subdomain, so tenant routing is implicit with no extra config
biggest_gap: Freshdesk MCP auth is a full-power personal API key in a header, and action quotas are small (100/month on Growth during EAP)
